title: A colour in Animate a property shows its swatch
goal: In the Animate a property list, a colour value (Color, Shadow 1 color, Border color) shows a small swatch of the colour it has now, the way the mock draws it, instead of the same diamond every number gets.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video.html renderPicker: colour entries draw <span class="sw" style="background:still"> (.pick-i .sw 12x12, radius 3, 1px --edge-lo) where others draw ic-keyframe. App: PickerRow in Sources/Photonz/PropertyKeysInspector.swift draws Image(systemName: "diamond") for every row. Found while comparing the list with the mock in animate-a-property-opens-closes-and-keys-a-value (2026-10-06). The mock says colour in the unit column; the app says color, which is the app spelling everywhere else (Shadow 1 color), so that one is not a difference to fix.
acceptance: Every colour row in Animate a property shows a 12pt rounded swatch of its current colour where number rows show the diamond
The swatch has the low edge round it, so a white or black colour still reads on the list in light and dark
animate-a-property-list-walk photographs a list with a colour row and the swatch is in the picture
